HLA_ClassI_status: Caris tumour WES and Guardant360 blood cfDNA both report HLA-A*01:01, A*33:03, B*08:01, B*15:08, C*01:02 and C*07:02; Caris notes that tumour sequencing does not replace blood-based histocompatibility testing. No clinical blood-based histocompatibility typing report or phased Class-II typing report is supplied in the repository.
assay_specific_TMB: Stanford STAMP (physical pp. 1-2) reports research-use tissue TMB 7.0 mut/Mb; Caris (pp. 1-2) reports tissue TMB 3 mut/Mb; Guardant360 (p. 1) reports blood TMB 7.59 mut/Mb. Different assays, genomic scopes and specimen types prevent treating these as a calibrated longitudinal TMB series. None establishes vaccine response.

clinically_reported_fusion.caris_report_annotation: Caris RNA-Tumor Seq (pp. 2, 17) reports pathogenic in-frame CDH1:NRG1 fusion with printed splice site exon 10:exon 6 and printed transcript IDs NM_001317184.2/NM_001159999.3.

clinically_reported_fusion.nrg1_refseq_exon_ordinal_equivalence: The NRG1 5' boundary chr8:32727949:+ is the first base of an exon in all 23 curated RefSeq NRG1 transcripts (UCSC ncbiRefSeqCurated, hg38), but the exon ordinal is transcript-dependent: exon 6 on the Caris-printed NM_001159999.3 and on NM_001160004.3, NM_001160008.2, NM_004495.4, NM_013956.5, NM_013957.5, NM_013958.4, NM_013960.5 and NM_013964.5; exon 5 on NM_001159995.3, NM_001160002.2 and NM_001322201.2; exon 4 on NM_001160001.3, NM_001160005.2, NM_001160007.2, NM_001322202.2 and NM_013962.3; and exon 2 on NM_001159996.3, NM_001322197.2, NM_001322205.2, NM_001322206.2, NM_001322207.2 and NM_013959.4. The genomic breakpoint, not an exon ordinal, is the stable identifier for this join. These ordinals are external RefSeq annotation geometry, not a measurement re-derived from this project's sequencing evidence.

clinically_reported_fusion.stanford_stamp_status: The Stanford STAMP report does not report this fusion.

guardant360_panel_coverage_and_B2M_limit: Thirteen of Design 4's fifteen somatic mutation genes (KLF5, SF1, AQP3, HSPG2, PPIC, KCTD19, VPS11, ARHGAP40, PLEC, SYT12, H2BC12, TJP2, FES) are not on Guardant360's 744-gene panel (methods p. 8; gene list p. 9, Table 1), so their status in Oct 2025 plasma cfDNA and progressing lesions is unmeasured rather than excluded. Guardant360 lists B2M^ (covering SNVs, indels and promoter methylation '^') and reports no B2M alteration in this specimen; per Table 1 footnotes (p. 9), B2M is not marked for copy-number amplification ('†') or deletion ('*'), and HLA-A/B/C carry '§' (SNVs/indels and somatic LOH not reported).
histology_tumour_cellularity: Approximately 60-70% histological tumour cellularity in Stanford pathology (~60% on STAMP); remaining tissue includes background liver parenchyma/stroma. Histological cellularity does not measure the malignant vs non-malignant bulk RNA transcript mixture fraction.

immunohistochemistry_and_wts_context.caris_ihc_and_cna: ERBB2/HER2 (4B5) negative (Score 0) and CNA-Seq Amplification Not Detected; PD-L1 (SP142) negative (0%); MSI Stable; TMB Low (3 mut/Mb); Genomic LOH Low (8% across 552 autosomal segments). The Caris p. 12 karyotype plots complex segmental gains and losses. Representative gains include chr1q, chr13q and segments of chr7, chr20q and chr22; representative losses include 1p, chr3, 4q, 5p, distal 9p and chr21. Chr6 appears at plotted copy number 2. These are nonexhaustive visual observations, not validated gene-level or allele-specific copy-number calls.
immunohistochemistry_and_wts_context.caris_wts_cohort_percentiles: Selected cohort percentiles (p. 11): VEGFA 99, SMAD4 99, ERBB3 94, NECTIN4 94, PRAME 92, LAG3 91, ADORA2A 90, CLDN6 90, NRG1 86, PDCD1 (PD-1) 86, PDCD1LG2 78, CTLA4 75, CD274 (PD-L1) 72, CLDN18 57, ERBB2 22, MSLN 8, TACSTD2 (TROP2) 4. Bulk WTS mixes tumour, immune, stromal and liver transcripts.
immunohistochemistry_and_wts_context.stanford_ihc: Stanford pathology/IHC physical pp. 1-2: CK7 positive, CK20 focal positive, MLH1/MSH2/MSH6/PMS2 intact, HER2 (4B5) negative (0), SATB2 weak subset positive, beta-catenin negative (membranous staining pattern); 2025-01-21 addendum: Claudin-18.2 (43-14A) limited expression (2-3+, 50%; below >=75% companion-diagnostic threshold).

longitudinal_cfDNA_and_narrative_context.draws_compared: Guardant360 plasma draws on 2025-03-29 (epigenomic Tumour Fraction 1.4%) and 2025-10-14 (reported 2025-10-21; epigenomic Tumour Fraction 31.9%, blood TMB 7.59 mut/Mb, MSI-High Not detected, HRD Not detected).
longitudinal_cfDNA_and_narrative_context.historical_BCOR_call_outside_executed_lo: Guardant360 p. 3 reports BCOR L1632P at 0.2% on 2025-03-29 and Not Detected on 2025-10-14. BCOR reference transcripts are available and a reference-based SNV candidate can be inferred, but the report row does not provide a transcript accession or nucleotide allele to authenticate that mapping.
longitudinal_cfDNA_and_narrative_context.liver_biopsy_variants_also_detected_in_o: Seven Guardant360-covered somatic alterations present in the 2025-01-15 liver biopsy were also detected in 2025-10-14 cfDNA (clonality and anatomical lesion attribution remain unestablished from pooled plasma cfDNA): ROS1 F1699F (1.6% -> 21.4%, synonymous SNV), TERT c.-124C>T (0.6% -> 20.5%, noncoding promoter SNV), MERTK E192* (1.0% -> 19.4%, stop-gain with 0 ALT / 25 REF liver WTS fragments [23 coding-strand REF], compatible with NMD or absent mutant transcription in the sampled biopsy rather than proof of NMD), JUN R276* (1.2% -> 14.8%, stop-gain creating no novel amino-acid sequence), RXRA A214S/A241S (0.5% -> 12.1%, encoded AG04), TGFBR2 N515Kfs*26/N490fs (0.7% -> 11.7%, encoded AG06) and CDH1::NRG1 (0.4% -> 9.3%, encoded AG24).
longitudinal_cfDNA_and_narrative_context.other_oct_2025_cfDNA_and_potential_CHIP_: KMT2D p.R2789Q (c.8366G>A, chr12:49039222:C>T) rose from 0.2% to 3.2% cfDNA VAF (16.0x across a 22.8x epigenomic tumour-fraction increase; cancer-cell fraction and lesion origin unestablished; 2560/3 (not_called_in_supplied_vcf) liver WES fragments; 139/0 liver WTS fragments; reference-model predictions show AlphaMissense=0.1775 and unverified splice scores [Atlas MERGED_SPLICING=1.50137; observed lung SPLICE_SITES max prob diff 0.63249, SPLICE_SITE_USAGE max frac diff 0.41507, SPLICE_JUNCTIONS max log-count diff 2.94336] that do not establish splicing alteration without progressing-lesion RNA). Five low-VAF calls appeared only on 2025-10-14 (AR P555S 0.4%, DHX36 L147L 0.3%, ERBB4 D113V 0.3%, DHX36 R160K 0.2%, RAF1 G535S 0.2%; lesion origin and transcription unestablished). Guardant360 annotates DNMT3A p.C351Afs*56 (chr2:25247121:CAAAA>C; 0.2% -> 0.1% cfDNA VAF; 0/58 normal WBC, 0/4,108 liver WES, 0/234 liver WTS fragments) as potential clonal hematopoiesis (potential CHIP); it is excluded from targeting.
longitudinal_cfDNA_and_narrative_context.project_narrative_timeline: Per data/clinical-timeline.md and rnafoundry.com/yash/ (outside the four clinical PDFs): initial response to zenocutuzumab after five FOLFIRINOX cycles (CA19-9 ~45,000 -> 18), followed in Aug-Oct 2025 by lung and peritoneal progression while liver and pancreatic lesions were described as controlled; an Oct 2025 peritoneal biopsy yielded insufficient tissue; treatment switched in Nov 2025 in India to gemcitabine/nab-paclitaxel plus rash-limited afatinib.

pharmacogenomics: Guardant360 (p. 2) reports UGT1A1 *1/*28 Intermediate Metabolizer (increased irinotecan toxicity risk) and CYP2D6 *4/*41 Intermediate Metabolizer (activity score 0.25); DPYD, HLA-B*57:01 and TPMT had no abnormal reportable alleles detected.
